snippet.title: RatScum - Official Developer Overview Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Take a look at the Developer Overview Trailer for RatScum, a hand-drawn adventure game developed by Eclair Games. Players will traverse a broken world to return home as a rat. Solve puzzles, avoid dangers, and uncover tales behind the walls in RatScum, coming soon to PC (Steam).
